decisions.statement: A slug past the hundred characters a page's slug holds is refused.
A slug's length is bounded here as it is where a page is composed.
A slug that is no slug, or the slug the page carries, is refused.
A slug a page of that page type carries already is refused.
A body exporting no name its slug makes is refused.
A page naming this page under a key its property's slug does not spell is restated.
A name handed in is stated where the page states another name.
A call handing in no name leaves the name the page states alone.
A value the page states that is the slug the page carried is restated too.
The id, the page type and the name are left alone where a value echoes that way.
Such a value is looked for in the page's own body and nowhere else.
The export is spelled anew over the bodies the restating leaves.
The module spelling an export anew is called rather than reached through a rung.

definition: one page's slug restated in its own body, in every page naming it and in its export
